usage: 櫃 is a noun that refers to a piece of furniture used for storage, similar to a cabinet or cupboard.
You can use 櫃 to talk about different types of storage furniture, such as 衣櫃 (wardrobe) or 書櫃 (bookshelf).
櫃 often appears in compound nouns where a specific function or location is described before 櫃.
When talking about items inside 櫃, you can use measure words like 個 or 張 depending on the context.
櫃 can also refer to specific types of cabinets, like 冰櫃 (freezer cabinet) when combined with other words.
